title: Infrastructure Access Attestation
description: Attests that the holder is authorized to access a specific physical resource.

granted_resource.description: Identifier of the physical resource the holder may access (e.g. lock-001)

grant_id.description: Internal grant reference for audit purposes

valid_from.description: ISO 8601 date from which the access right is valid

valid_until.description: ISO 8601 date until which the access right is valid

cnf.description: Key confirmation — wallet public key (proof of possession)

status.description: Token Status List reference for revocation
